background.value: Light grey or white (ICAO standard, as referenced by Slovenian government)

head_height.value: Face height 32-36 mm (70-80% of photograph), per ICAO standard

face_visibility.value: Frontal view, face clearly visible, in accordance with ICAO standards

headwear_policy.value: Not permitted except for religious or medical reasons (ICAO standard)

size.evidence: The official Slovenian embassy page (gov.si) was fetched directly and states the photo dimension for a long-stay (D) visa is '45x35 mm, conform to ICAO standards'. This is 35x45mm (width x height), matching the claimed value. Additionally, Slovenia is a Schengen country; the standard Schengen visa photo size is 35x45mm, which is confirmed by schengenvisainfo.com and other independent sources. The dimension is the same whether written as 35x45mm or 45x35mm (height x width notation).
